propositions: Plan-review findings recalled from prior sidecars are injected with hardcoded empty evidence and impact, breaking Pass-2 re-verification and causing verbatim replay on every subsequent review even after the plan addresses them

Recalled findings are re-persisted indistinguishably from fresh findings because the _recall marker is dropped by the allow-list, causing them to re-qualify for recall on the next run, creating a permanent ratchet

Prior findings with persisted evidence are never read by prior_concerns, so Pass-2 verifiers cannot re-ground the original claim's quotes against the current plan text and instead rubber-stamp bare assertions

Recall eligibility filters only on decision and priority, never consulting the prior sidecar's material_fingerprint, so findings are recalled even when the material has changed and the fresh finder's silence indicates the edit resolved the finding

Evidence-less prior findings and those from sidecars with mismatched material_fingerprint must be excluded from recall eligibility to break the ratchet and defer to fresh-finding detection on changed plans
